review_scope.command: pilot workload Kubernetes Job container argv

checklist.lesson: Validate actual committed governance artifacts and preserve typed refusal detail before any mutation.
checklist.workload_application: The argv source is hash-bound with all executor modules; pilot_rows writes the command binding before applying Kubernetes objects and retains bounded typed diagnostics on refusal.

checklist.lesson: Model real service constraints in rehearsal rather than allowing permissive fakes.
checklist.workload_application: The renderer and verifier execute identically in live and rehearsal; workload invariants are enforced by one shared static audit.

checklist.lesson: Bind and verify exact bytes rather than relying on a transport label.
checklist.workload_application: Deployment uses the exact scan-passed child digest and persists the NUL-delimited full container argv SHA-256 before execution.

checklist.lesson: A security tool's coverage must match the claimed gate.
checklist.workload_application: No in-workload scan claim exists; the pod can run only after the supplementary ECR OS gate and digest-verified pinned Scout package gate pass.

checklist.lesson: Every executor module is bound unconditionally, including skipped stages.
checklist.workload_application: Both the workload source and renderer are members of the unconditional attempt-17 executor module set.

checklist.lesson: External failures require bounded sanitized exit, stdout and stderr diagnostics.
checklist.workload_application: Job refusal captures the wait return path plus sanitized bounded Job, Pod, Event and log diagnostics before cleanup; frozen inputs are public research and contain no PHI.

checklist.lesson: Runtime evidence must live outside the reviewed worktree until terminal evidence is committed.
checklist.workload_application: Job command binding and diagnostics are written to the existing external attempt workdir and never to the reviewed tree during execution.

checklist.lesson: Slow transfers need pre-staging, progress and an explicit window budget.
checklist.workload_application: The Job performs no remote model or audio download; all inputs are node-local, pre-staged and hash-verified before the Job starts.

checklist.lesson: Stage wrappers must preserve their exact outer status contract.
checklist.workload_application: pilot_rows returns PASS_PILOT_ROWS only after Kubernetes completion and aggregate presence; refusal never aliases an inner status to PASS.

checklist.lesson: Rehearsal must run real composition code against recorded-real boundary shapes.
checklist.workload_application: LiveOperations.pilot_rows is the only stage implementation; rehearsal fakes only AWS, kubectl and external client boundaries.

checklist.lesson: Read-after-create readiness needs bounded stable polling.
checklist.workload_application: Pod discovery is bounded to 900 seconds and waits for exactly one pod with an IP; network isolation receipt and listener readiness must exist before release.

checklist.lesson: Local resource prerequisites must refuse before the attempt envelope.
checklist.workload_application: The existing pre-envelope disk, memory, CPU, process-limit, tool and Docker gates remain mandatory before any workload path.

checklist.lesson: All bounded helper call sites must share one contract and undergo static audit.
checklist.workload_application: The Job has an explicit 9,000-second active deadline, the listener has a 900-second monotonic timeout with exit 71, and the live wait uses the same 9,000-second contract.

checklist.lesson: A repeated readiness refusal must automatically capture describe, events and logs.
checklist.workload_application: Every pilot_rows exception writes bounded Job, Pod, Event and container-log diagnostics before cleanup, including which typed gate refused.

checklist.lesson: Reuse byte-identical proven commands where successful historical evidence exists and disclose unproven commands honestly.
checklist.workload_application: No successful historical workload exists, so the exact argv is bound and labeled NOT_HISTORICALLY_PROVEN; no proven claim is invented.

checklist.lesson: Do not depend on account-name resolution, ambient environment or relative executables.
checklist.workload_application: The pod uses numeric UID/GID 10001, an explicit environment, absolute /opt/venv/bin/python invocations, and no passwd/group lookup. The final pilot process replaces the shell with exec.

limitations: The audit proves source, composition and local/rehearsal behavior; it does not claim a live workload PASS.
GPU inference, the full 540-row loop and aggregate collection remain first-live operations for a separately approved attempt.
